items.quote: I just got my cats spay surgery over here. The process was very smooth and she got recovered very well. … He explained every step and medicines need to my cat in details.
items.name: Vikash Shelke

items.quote: Our cat Jenny had Panleukopenia at the last stage. We had almost given up hope. Dr. Pritesh treated her on priority without wasting a minute. He saved our baby. Truly the best vet in Pune.
items.name: Sneha R.

items.quote: Best exotic animal vet in Pune. Brought my parrot and turtle — both treated with expertise I’ve never seen anywhere else in PCMC. The in-house lab saved hours. Highly recommended.
items.name: Kavita S.
